x: The Pushable component provides methods for controlling whether an Arcade Physics body can bedisplaced by other bodies during collision resolution. A pushable body will have velocity appliedto it as a result of colliding with other bodies. A non-pushable body will instead reflect itsreceived velocity back to the colliding body, effectively acting as an immovable surface forpurposes of velocity transfer while still participating in positional separation. This componentis mixed into Game Objects that use Arcade Physics.

m.x: Sets if this Body can be pushed by another Body.A body that cannot be pushed will reflect back all of the velocity it is given to thecolliding body. If that body is also not pushable, then the separation will be splitbetween them evenly.If you want your body to never move or separate at all, see the `setImmovable` method.

p.x: Whether this body can be pushed by collisions with another Body.
